name: Planner - Projects
description: Plan a project together: milestones, the work with who does it and when, and what waits on what.
author: Coffee Pub

provides.name: addMilestone
provides.label: Add it to the plan as a milestone
provides.description: Add a milestone to the plan, on the day given if there is one.

inputHints.date: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD. The plan may need one.
inputHints.ref: A pointer to something this entry is about.
inputHints.object: A full description to add instead of the flat fields; its own day and words are used.
inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: addWork
provides.label: Add it to the plan as work
provides.description: Add work to the plan, from the start day to the end day given if there are any.

inputHints.start: First day, as YYYY-MM-DD; with only an end, it is a one-day span. The plan may need at least one day.
inputHints.end: Last day, as YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.
inputHints.owners: Who is doing it: keys or names as list_members shows them, separated by commas.
inputHints.ref: A pointer to something this entry is about.
inputHints.object: A full description to add instead of the flat fields; its own days and words are used.
inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: addNote
provides.label: Add it to the plan as a note
provides.description: Add a note to the plan.

inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: setDone
provides.label: Tick it off the plan
provides.description: Tick a milestone, or mark a piece of work done or not done.

provides.name: updateEntry
provides.label: Change it on the plan
provides.description: Change a plan entry's title, day, start, end, who is doing it or notes; only the fields given change.

inputHints.ref: The plan entry to change, as a pointer.
inputHints.date: A milestone's day, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty clears it.
inputHints.start: Work's first day, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty clears it.
inputHints.end: Work's last day, as YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start; empty clears it.
inputHints.owners: Work only. Replaces who is doing it: keys or names as list_members shows them, separated by commas; empty clears.
inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed.

settings.label: Dates are needed
settings.help: On: every milestone needs a date, and all work a start and an end. Off: dates are optional, and the Timeline shows only what has one.

settings.label: Waits on
settings.help: Let a milestone or work wait on others, and draw the lines between them on the Timeline.

settings.label: Opens on
settings.help: The view a person sees first. Their own choice wins once they pick one, and a phone opens on the List.

settings.label: Tags
settings.help: Tags a milestone, work or note may carry, such as a story thread or a team.
